newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BOXING-JOE BUGNER CALLS FOR LIFE BAN FOR TYSON.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-JOE BUGNER CALLS FOR LIFE BAN FOR TYSON.

text.p: Heavyweight boxing champion Joe Bugner on Monday called for Mike Tyson to be banned for life after biting off part of Evander Holyfield's ear in a title fight in Las Vegas on Saturday.
"What he did was the most outrageous thing I have seen in 30 years in boxing. I think he should be banned for life," Bugner told Reuters from his home in the Australian state of Queensland.

"He spat out his gum shield and bit part of the guy's ear off -- it was a cold, calculated, bloody decision by Tyson and there is no excuse for it," said Bugner, the Pan-Asian Boxing Association heavyweight champion.
Holyfield retained his World Boxing Association heavyweight title in Las Vegas on Saturday when Tyson was disqualified after three rounds for biting the champion's ears twice.
Bugner, at 47 one of the heavyweight fight veterans, said he had twice been bitten in his fighting career, but in both incidents the fighters did not spit out their mouth guard.

Bugner, who went the distance with both Muhammad Ali and Joe Frazier, said he understood the frustrations Tyson may have felt in the bout against Holyfield, but said there was no excuse for disregarding the rules of the sport.
"It was not as if Mike Tyson was in a rage because if he was he would not have had time to spit the gum shield out," he said.
"He thought he was bigger than the sport because of the magnitude of money he gets. I think it has put boxing back quite considerably."
